content.short: Alpha Quark is an NFT marketplace, NFT collateral lending service, and metaverse platform.
content.description: Alpha Quark unites an NFT marketplace, a collateral-based lending service, and a metaverse experience into a single platform. It enables NFT holders to treat their collections as collateral to secure loans from other users, turning dormant assets into selectable financing and income opportunities. By converting perceived value into liquidity, the platform expands the practical use of NFTs and gives creators and collectors new ways to monetize and leverage their holdings.
